<section class="course-intro" aria-labelledby="course-intro-title">
<div><p class="course-eyebrow">A MATLAB TOOLBOX FOR VITAL RATES SURVEILLANCE</p><h2 id="course-intro-title">Explore cancer rates.<br>Model age, period, and cohort.</h2><p>MATISSE is an advanced age-period-cohort (APC) modeling toolbox for vital rates surveillance. It provides all the outputs of the NCI web tool and adds smoothing, semiparametric, and comparative methods.</p><div class="course-actions"><a class="course-button" href="#course-modules">Start learning <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></a><a class="course-secondary" href="course-information.html">About the short course →</a></div><p class="course-audience">For epidemiologists, cancer registry researchers, and biostatisticians.</p></div>

<a class="course-video-card" href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CLSP755kp4I" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="Watch Welcome to MATISSE on YouTube, 2 minutes 8 seconds, opens in a new tab">
<div class="course-video-preview"><img src="https://i.ytimg.com/vi/CLSP755kp4I/hqdefault.jpg" alt="" loading="lazy"><span class="course-video-play" aria-hidden="true">▶</span><span class="course-video-duration">2:08</span></div>
<div class="course-video-caption"><strong>Welcome to MATISSE</strong><span>Watch the MATISSE tour on YouTube ↗</span></div>
</a></section>
<section class="course-outcomes" aria-labelledby="course-outcomes-title"><h2 id="course-outcomes-title">What MATISSE can do</h2><ul><li>Fit the new APC model and read its six estimable functions.</li><li>Draw standard plots and Lexis diagrams of your rates.</li><li>Smooth noisy rates with SIFT and fit SAGE models.</li><li>Compare APC results across groups.</li></ul></section>
<section id="course-modules" class="course-modules" aria-labelledby="course-modules-title">
<div class="course-section-heading"><div><p class="course-eyebrow">START HERE</p><h2 id="course-modules-title">Your learning path</h2></div><p>Watch → Read → Run the code</p></div>
<p>Work through the four steps in order, or jump to the one you need. Open a step to find its videos, slides, and practice task. Resource links open in a new tab.</p>

<details class="course-module" open><summary><span class="module-number">01</span><span class="module-heading"><strong>Getting started with APC modeling</strong><span>Learn the basics of age-period-cohort modeling.</span></span><span class="module-toggle" aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><div class="module-body">
<div class="module-group"><p class="module-group-title">Learn the basics</p>
<div class="module-resources"><div class="resource-soon"><span>WATCH · COMING SOON</span>What APC modeling is for, and why epidemiologists use it</div><a href="downloads/Statistical_Methods_in_CSR.pptx"><span>READ · SLIDES</span>Statistical methods in cancer surveillance ↗</a><a href="downloads/Filho_Rosenberg_2024_FrontOncol.pdf"><span>READ · METHODS PAPER</span>Advances in cancer surveillance methods ↗</a></div></div>
<div class="module-group"><p class="module-group-title">Where to start</p>
<div class="module-resources"><a href="downloads/SEER_CI5plus_to_APC_WebTool.pptx"><span>READ · SLIDES</span>Extract SEER and CI5 Plus data ↗</a><a href="https://analysistools.cancer.gov/apc/"><span>RUN · NCI WEB TOOL</span>Run APC modeling with the NCI web tool ↗</a></div></div>
<div class="module-practice"><strong>Where to start: prepare your data</strong><p>The NCI web tool needs an input matrix of case counts and population by age group and calendar period. Age and period intervals must be equal in width, so 5-year age groups need 5-year periods. No count or population cell can be zero. The slides above show how to build this matrix from SEER*Stat (US data) or from the CI5 Plus database. Then run your analysis in the web tool.</p><a href="https://analysistools.cancer.gov/apc/">analysistools.cancer.gov/apc ↗</a></div></div></details>

<details class="course-module"><summary><span class="module-number">02</span><span class="module-heading"><strong>What is MATISSE?</strong><span>MATISSE is an advanced APC modeling toolbox for vital rates surveillance.</span></span><span class="module-toggle" aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><div class="module-body">
<div class="module-resources"><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CLSP755kp4I"><span>WATCH · 2:08</span>MATISSE tour ↗</a><a href="course-information.html"><span>LIVE COURSE</span>Short course: format and schedule →</a></div>
<div class="module-group"><p class="module-group-title">Why MATISSE?</p>
<div class="module-why">
<div><strong>Want higher-resolution results?</strong><p>MATISSE can interpolate 5-year age groups to 1-year age groups. Run <code>help rates/i5</code> to see how.</p></div>
<div><strong>Want to smooth the data?</strong><p>SIFT smooths a matrix of rates. SAGE then fits the APC model to the smoothed rates. <a href="examples.html#advanced-methods">See the examples →</a></p></div>
<div><strong>Want to compare modeled results?</strong><p>Comparative APC methods test whether rates from several groups share the same patterns. <a href="examples.html#comparative-apc">See the example →</a></p></div>
</div></div>
<div class="module-practice"><strong>Join the short course</strong><p>Live sessions are planned for late October 2026 (dates to be confirmed). Read about the format, the schedule, and the team.</p><a href="course-information.html">Short course details →</a></div></div></details>

<details class="course-module"><summary><span class="module-number">03</span><span class="module-heading"><strong>How to use MATISSE?</strong><span>Getting started with the toolbox</span></span><span class="module-toggle" aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><div class="module-body">
<div class="module-group"><p class="module-group-title">Set up</p>
<div class="module-resources"><a href="getting-started.html#getting-started-with-matlab-online"><span>READ · MATLAB GUIDE</span>Set up MATLAB Online →</a><a href="downloads/MATISSE_toolbox.zip"><span>DOWNLOAD</span>MATISSE toolbox ↗</a><a href="https://matlab.mathworks.com/open/github/v1?repo=filhoalm/MATISSE&amp;file=downloads/MATISSE_1_Overview.mlx"><span>OPEN</span>Overview live script in MATLAB Online ↗</a></div></div>
<div class="module-group"><p class="module-group-title">Meet the toolbox</p>
<div class="module-resources"><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6frwitiOJ_Y"><span>WATCH · 0:22</span>System map guide ↗</a><a href="downloads/Statistical_Methods_in_CSR.pptx"><span>READ · SLIDES</span>Statistical methods in cancer surveillance ↗</a><a href="downloads/MATISSE_1_Overview.mlx"><span>RUN · LIVE SCRIPT</span>MATISSE 1 Overview ↗</a></div></div>
<div class="module-group"><p class="module-group-title">Explore Lexis diagrams</p>
<div class="module-resources"><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dzQgEBVj48o"><span>WATCH · 0:43</span>Visualizing a Lexis diagram ↗</a><a href="downloads/The_Lexis_Diagram.pptx"><span>READ · SLIDES</span>The Lexis Diagram ↗</a><a href="downloads/MATISSE_2_The_Lexis_Diagram.mlx"><span>RUN · LIVE SCRIPT</span>MATISSE 2 The Lexis Diagram ↗</a></div></div>
<div class="module-group"><p class="module-group-title">Examples and resources</p>
<div class="module-resources"><a href="examples.html"><span>EXAMPLES</span>Worked examples with live scripts →</a><a href="resources.html"><span>RESOURCES</span>Downloads, papers, and FAQ →</a></div>
<p class="module-topics">The examples cover the <a href="examples.html#standard-plots">4 standard plots</a>, <a href="examples.html#visualizing-a-lexis-diagram">Lexis diagrams</a>, and the <a href="examples.html#estimable-functions">6 estimable functions</a>. Advanced methods have their own <a href="examples.html#advanced-methods">short examples</a>.</p></div>
<div class="module-practice"><strong>Try it in MATLAB</strong><p>Open MATLAB Online, unzip the toolbox, and add its folder and subfolders to the MATLAB path. Run the Overview live script one section at a time. Open the system map with <code>matisse('map')</code>, then load the example data and draw a heat map with <code>pcolor</code>.</p><a href="toolbox-guide.html#system-map">Read about the system map →</a></div></div></details>

<details class="course-module"><summary><span class="module-number">04</span><span class="module-heading"><strong>Advanced theory and analysis</strong><span>Uncover the theory of MATISSE and perform advanced analyses such as SIFT, SAGE, and comparative APC.</span></span><span class="module-toggle" aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><div class="module-body">
<div class="module-group"><p class="module-group-title">Theory and videos</p>
<div class="module-resources"><div class="resource-soon"><span>READ · SLIDES · COMING SOON</span>Theory and statistical formulas</div><a href="https://www.youtube.com/@filhoam"><span>WATCH · YOUTUBE CHANNEL</span>MATISSE on YouTube: on-demand lectures ↗</a></div></div>
<div class="module-group"><p class="module-group-title">Method papers</p>
<div class="module-resources cols-4"><a href="https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/0962280218801121"><span>APC MODEL</span>The new age-period-cohort model ↗</a><a href="https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/09622802231192950"><span>SIFT</span>Smoothing methods for Lexis diagrams ↗</a><a href="https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jamanetworkopen/fullarticle/2819747"><span>SAGE</span>Semiparametric APC analysis ↗</a><a href="https://link.springer.com/article/10.1186/s12874-023-02039-8"><span>COMPARATIVE APC</span>Comparative APC analysis ↗</a></div></div>
<div class="module-practice"><strong>Try an advanced method</strong><p>Choose SIFT to smooth noisy rates, SAGE to fit the APC model to smoothed rates, or comparative APC to compare groups. Read the short description, then open the method paper.</p><a href="examples.html#advanced-methods">See the advanced examples →</a></div></div></details>

<p>Philip S. Rosenberg, PhD, developed the MATISSE toolbox and its code. The toolbox implements methods developed with the cancer surveillance research community. These include the APC methods described in Filho &amp; Rosenberg, Front Oncol 2024. The team listed above develops the course.</p>
</section><section id="faq" class="home-faq"><h2>FAQ</h2><details><summary>Do I need to buy MATLAB to use MATISSE?</summary><p>You can use MATLAB Online in your browser. Sign in with a MathWorks account and check the current access terms. Follow <a href="getting-started.html#getting-started-with-matlab-online" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Getting started with MATLAB Online</a> to set up the toolbox. You need a MATLAB license to use a local copy.</p></details><details><summary>Do I need to know MATLAB already?</summary><p>Some familiarity helps. Start with the Overview live script to learn how the toolbox works. Run one section at a time and inspect the result. Use <a href="toolbox-guide.html#getting-help" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Getting help</a> when a command is unfamiliar.</p></details><details><summary>Is MATISSE peer reviewed / published?</summary><p>The methods are described in Filho &amp; Rosenberg, <em>Advances in statistical methods for cancer surveillance research: an age-period-cohort perspective</em> (Front Oncol, 2024). Download the paper from <a href="resources.html#downloads">Downloads</a>. For individual methods, such as SAGE and comparative APC analysis, open <a href="resources.html#related-methods-and-publications">Related methods and publications</a>.</p></details><details><summary>How do I ask a question or get help?</summary><p>Send us an email at <a href="mailto:matisse.apc@gmail.com">matisse.apc@gmail.com</a>. For quick answers about commands, use the toolbox's built-in help. See <a href="toolbox-guide.html#getting-help" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Getting help</a> for the commands.</p></details><details><summary>Will the live sessions be recorded?</summary><p>Yes. Recordings will be linked here when they are available.</p></details></section></div>
